items.title_en: DJ Giddens - In line for bump in playing time
items.summary_en: Giddens will likely move up to the No. 2 RB role for the Colts in the short term, as Seth McGowan is expected to miss time due to a hamstring injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.title: DJ Giddens deve ganhar mais tempo em campo
items.summary: Giddens deve virar o RB2 dos Colts no curto prazo, já que Seth McGowan deve desfalcar o time por lesão no posterior da coxa, segundo o The Athletic.

items.title: Athan Kaliakmanis é o QB de emergência
items.summary: Kaliakmanis (decisão técnica) está inativo, mas serve como terceiro QB de emergência dos Commanders contra os Bengals na segunda-feira.

items.title: Chargers lamentam não ter usado mais Omarion Hampton antes

items.title_en: DK Metcalf will not be suspended by NFL
items.summary_en: The NFL is not expected to suspend WR DK Metcalf for his actions after he was ejected from Sunday's game against the Eagles.

items.title_en: Drake Maye - Remains on active roster, but out indefinitely
items.summary_en: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN reports.
items.title: Drake Maye segue no elenco ativo, mas sem prazo de volta
items.summary: Com fratura na fíbula direita sofrida na Semana 10, Maye continua no elenco de 53 em vez da IR, por gestão das vagas de retorno da IR, segundo Mike Vrabel. Está fora por tempo indeterminado.

items.title_en: Seth McGowan - Will miss time with hamstring injury
items.summary_en: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.
items.title: Seth McGowan vai desfalcar por lesão no posterior
items.summary: Shane Steichen disse que McGowan ficará fora por algum tempo após lesionar o posterior da coxa na derrota por 26-3 para os Texans.

items.summary_en: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.
items.title: Terrance Ferguson precisa de cirurgia e não volta da IR
items.summary: Sean McVay disse que Ferguson não será ativado da IR nesta temporada e passará por cirurgia no tornozelo, lesão agravada na Semana 3.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk é dispensado pelos 49ers
